quest.title: The Moon Has Risen
quest.description: The Inazuman angler Kujirai Momiji has something that she wants help with...

talks.objective: Talk to the Inazuman fisherwoman Kujirai Momiji

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: "Lunar Leviathan"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What "Lunar Leviathan"?

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Oh, hey there! You must be the fisherman sent by the Adventurers' Guild, huh? I'm Kujirai Momiji, an Inazuman fisherwoman.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: I heard about you from the Fishing Association. Seeing you today, you are indeed as young and promising as they said. I hope I didn't get the wrong person.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Recently I have been searching for a fish that is from legends. It's called the "Lunar Leviathan". According to the legends, it has the power to grant people's wishes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wowee — a wish-granting fish! Paimon likes these kinds of legends!

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Hmph, even though everyone believes they are just legends...I believe it's real.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Because a few years ago, I may have personally encountered a "Lunar Leviathan"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did it grant your wish?

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Well... kind of. The story goes like this...

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: A couple of years ago, because of each of our respective wishes, two friends and myself set out to sea to pursue the "Lunar Leviathan". One was Jiawei and the other was Nantuck.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: But the journey was turbulent. We encountered a violent thunderstorm. And although our fishing boat survived, our compass got damaged and we were lost in an unknown patch of ocean.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: A few days later, we still could not find the way home. We were out of fresh water and though no one said anything, everyone was getting desperate.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: To the point where one night, Jiawei wrote a suicide note, put it in a bottle and was about to throw it out to sea.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: He didn't know but we weren't asleep at the time. We heard him sneaking out and we rushed to grabbed him. And in that moment we all saw a giant shape under the water.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: The shape glowed faintly, shining little by little, as if pieces of the moon were dropped underwater.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Was it a "Lunar Leviathan"? We were desperate so we believed so, we asked it to grant us safe return to our homeland.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Yep, whether you can believe it or not, we survived. When the magical shape began swimming away, we followed it and it led us back home.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww...That's such a touching legend!

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: No! It's true! Believe me! We can definitely find it again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What should we do?

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Well let's go find my old pals first. They're both seasoned fishermen and having them accompany us would help a great deal.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Jiawei is located at Liyue Harbor,</color> I heard once he returned to Liyue he never left again. I'm sure he still reminisces about the "Lunar Leviathan" as well.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: As for Nantuck, I heard he started writing books about marine biology. When you meet Jiawei, you can ask him where he is.

talks.objective: Talk to the Liyue fisherman Jiawei

dialogues.speaker: Jiawei
dialogues.text: The ocean is like a beautiful woman, only a welcoming sight every so often...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you Jiawei?

dialogues.speaker: Jiawei
dialogues.text: Yes, what do you want?

dialogues.speaker: Jiawei
dialogues.text: Oh — the "Lunar Leviathan"! Of course it's about the "Lunar Leviathan"! That experience really stays with you.

dialogues.speaker: Jiawei
dialogues.text: As for Kujirai, she also did not forget. Her wish was... Uh... Um, uhh...

dialogues.speaker: Jiawei
dialogues.text: Then I will send you off with my best wishes, I hope you guys succeed!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? We came here to invite you, don't you want to come with us?

dialogues.speaker: Jiawei
dialogues.text: Ah! I nearly lost my life at that time. The ocean is like a beautiful woman, only a welcoming sight every so often...

dialogues.speaker: Jiawei
dialogues.text: Additionally, as a married man, how could I abandon my family? I must take on the role of being head of the household!

dialogues.speaker: Jiawei
dialogues.text: After all the hard work and sweat I put in to marry such a generous and wonderful woman! So, I must apologize...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your old pal will be disappointed.

dialogues.speaker: Jiawei
dialogues.text: Don't talk like that...let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Jiawei
dialogues.text: Although I cannot accompany you on your journey, I will help in another way. I will pass on my years of fishing experience and knowledge to you.

dialogues.speaker: Jiawei
dialogues.text: A legendary creature like the "Lunar Leviathan" will not be caught easily.

dialogues.speaker: Jiawei
dialogues.text: So, accept my training, inherit my knowledge and then go pursue the legendary fish!

dialogues.speaker: Jiawei
dialogues.text: Oh, right? Aren't you guys in a hurry to find Nantuck? Don't worry, that guy's been hibernating like an old sea turtle. He's stayed in Mondstadt all this time, it's said that he's writing a book?

dialogues.speaker: Jiawei
dialogues.text: Now focus! Jiawei's magical fishing training is about to begin! Once training is over, you can go look for him.

dialogues.speaker: Kujirai Momiji
dialogues.text: Have you found Jiawei and Nantuck?
